summary_md: **Harli Feijie Wu ([@harli_wu](https://x.com/harli_wu/status/2116276310804746615))** presents **HeurEvo** ([arXiv 2609.36303](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36303)) in an 11-part thread: agents evolve plans, code and a shared component library offline to combine heuristics and Gurobi under a 120 s limit, beating Gurobi's 48-hour incumbents on 7 of 11 tasks (mean gap -1.45%) and improving on AdaEvolve on MIPLIB and nonlinear problems.
